title: Banff Lake Louise Excursion - 3-Day Calgary To Vancouver Bus Tour
includes: 2-day coach tour and 1 transfer from Calgary to Banff
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Rockies Highlights from Calgary offers travellers the opportunity to see the Canadian Rockies on the way to Vancouver. Your hotels are cradled in the midst of the majestic mountains of the Banff; providing opportunities to soak in the charm of these towns of yesteryear. 

The highlights between the stops include world famous turquoise lakes, deep canyons. Our deluxe coach will comfortably takes you to most popular highlights in Banff National Park, while our mountain tour guide brings these regions to life. 

Please note: Once your booking is confirmed, it is non-refundable under any circumstance, including medical emergencies. We strongly recommend travel insurance for protection against unexpected changes.
